description_sq:
Apartament unik 4+1+3 dhe 2 parkime!
Ofrojme per shitje nje nga pronat me unike ne treg, tek nje ndertim elitar ne Komunen e Parisit.
Siperfaqe totale 226 m², organizuar ne: 4 dhoma gjumi; sallon i madh; 3 tualete dhe verande ne forme "L", e bollshme dhe me pamje te hapur.
2 poste parkimi te perfshira ne cmim.
Per vizite ne prone apo informacione te metejshme kontaktoni tani.
description_en: Unique apartment 4+1+3 and 2 parkings! We offer for sale one of the most unique properties on the market, in an elite building in the Municipality of Paris. Total area 226 m², organized in: 4 bedrooms; large living room; 3 toilets and "L" shaped veranda, spacious and with an open view. 2 parking spaces included in the price. For a visit to the property or more information, contact us now.
